snippet.title: Sesari - A short, haunted science-fiction video game set in the middle of the desert!
snippet.description:
Download for free https://sesarigame.com/ Content warning: Self-immolation, contains scenes that may disturb or upset some players. 

Sesari is a haunted science-fiction video game, to be released one death at a time, forever.

At a gas station in the middle of the desert, two women suddenly and completely lose their memory. It gets worse (and weirder) from there.

➡️ More horror games https://itch.io/games/tag-horror?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
